task_id.description: Wait for this background task to finish (or, with pattern, to print a matching line)

port.description: Wait until this TCP port accepts connections

path.description: Wait until this file exists (or, with pattern, contains a matching line)

changed.description: With path: wait until the file is created, modified or deleted after the call starts

pattern.description: Regular expression matched line by line against the task output or the file

timeout.description: Maximum time to wait in milliseconds (max 600000)

description.description: A short label of what this call works on or looks for, shown to the user as its row: a noun phrase of 2 to 6 words, no leading verb
